def get_digit_count(n):
    count = 0
    while n != 0:
        n //= 10
        count += 1
    return count

def compute_base(n):
    digits = get_digit_count(n)
    base = 0
    power = 1
    for _ in range(digits):
        base += power
        power *= 10
    if base <= n:
        return base
    return (base - 1) // 10

def solve_number(n):
    if n <= 6:
        return n
    if n <= 11:
        return 13 - n
    base_value = compute_base(n)
    boundary = base_value * 10 + 1
    if n % base_value == 0:
        quotient = n // base_value
        if n <= boundary // 2 + base_value:
            return get_digit_count(base_value) * quotient
        else:
            diff = solve_number(boundary - n)
            return get_digit_count(boundary) + diff
    else:
        lower = (n // base_value) * base_value
        upper = (n // base_value + 1) * base_value
        total_res = solve_number(lower) + solve_number(n - lower)
        if n > boundary // 2:
            total_res = min(solve_number(lower) + solve_number(n - lower),
                            get_digit_count(boundary) + solve_number(boundary - n))
        return total_res

n = int(input())
print(solve_number(n))
